title: Instagram Views Per Content Format by Account Size
sourceTitle: Instagram Views Per Content Format Benchmark
sampleDescription: Aggregated cross-industry analysis of business and creator accounts segmented by follower tiers
limitations: Metrics represent arithmetic averages (means) across tiers, which may be influenced by top-end accounts in each bracket
Sample focuses on accounts connected to Socialinsider's benchmarking index
Does not account for differences in posting frequency or niche saturation
